_comment: Sub-regions of country code 94 (Netherlands) in the `area` archive. Keys are the records' own indices, `ru` is the original of the language slot this mod overwrites and `ua` its replacement; the index is what the console reports over the network, so no row is moved or renamed into a different place. Other language slots keep Nintendo's own names. See src/strings/area/EU_country.json for the country list and tools/area.py for the sort ranks, which are recomputed from these names.
